title: Compact responsive pricing tooltip and model-migration screenshots
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and export a compact set of product screenshots and UX assets for the upcoming model catalog release notes. Focus is on a compact pricing tooltip UI that surfaces per-token cost, typical latency tier, and a migration compatibility hint when a model is deprecated. Deliverables include responsive screenshots (mobile/compact/desktop), dark-mode variants, and localized German/Japanese variants for the tooltip content and migration banner. These assets will be used in the docs release notes, Quickstart onboarding, and the marketing release email.
acceptance_criteria: Tooltip shows token cost, average latency, and 'compatibility tier' tag in a compact 320px width layout
Screenshots exported at 1x and 2x for small (320px), medium (768px), and desktop (1240px) breakpoints
Dark-mode and light-mode variants present with color tokens matching design system
Localized screenshots: de-DE and ja-JP text overlays exported and verified by PM
Figma source file with named export frames and redline annotations shared; final PNG/SVG assets uploaded to Drive
Alt text and short caption provided for each screenshot for docs consumption
high_level_notes: New compact tooltip attempts to reduce cognitive load for release notes while still exposing cost drivers (tokens, batching effect, cache hit) with a micro-graph
Include a small 'compatibility tier' chip (A/B/C) that maps deprecated models to recommended replacements and shows migration risk
Tooltip should collapse non-critical lines on very small widths and surface a 'View details' CTA that links to docs
Avoid repeating the full pricing table; keep the visual that embeds the token-meter and an estimated cost-per-1k-tokens line
Design must be easily reusable in marketing email banners, so keep a clean safe-area and 3:1 aspect variations
screenshots_considerations: Mobile frames must simulate realistic browser chrome and have the Quickstart overlay visible
Ensure token-meter micrograph degrades to a static icon on @1x exports to avoid blurriness
For deprecation states, show a subtle faded model tile with 'Deprecated' ribbon and migration hint
CTA buttons use primary color token from design system and should be visually distinct in dark mode
Check contrast ratios for small text in tooltip: must meet WCAG 3.0 AA for normal text where possible
visual_specs: Typography: Inter 14/16 for tooltip body, 12 for captions
Spacing: 8px grid inside tooltip; outer safe margin 16px
Colors: use tokens --surface/--text/--muted; dark-mode equivalents included in Figma file
Export: PNGs for docs, SVG for icons, source frames named with locale and breakpoint suffix
localization_targets: de-DE (German) - PM to provide final copy by 2026-03-10
